body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose up to two adjacent creatures within natural weapon range. Compare this Action against each. On a success, deal 1 Bludgeoning damage. After this resolves, you may become Unstable; if you do, increase your natural weapon reach by 1 until your next turn.

surges.html: Ignore the next die you would burn because of a damage Condition before your next turn.
Choose one additional adjacent target for this Action.

rider.title: TITAN ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Colossal Frame. While maintained: Increase your reach by 1 unit and the distance you forcibly move creatures by 1 unit.
